title: Database Cleanup
description: Speed up a sluggish WordPress site — revisions, spam, transients, and orphaned metadata.

steps.title: Take Full Backup First
steps.instructions: Export the database and files before any cleanup. Never run bulk deletes without a restore point.

steps.title: Trim Post Revisions
steps.instructions: Limit or remove old post revisions beyond your retention policy (e.g. keep last 5 per post). Use a trusted plugin or WP-CLI.

steps.title: Empty Spam & Trash
steps.instructions: Permanently delete spam comments, trashed posts, and trashed media. Empty the trash in Comments and Posts.

steps.title: Clear Expired Transients
steps.instructions: Remove expired transients and orphaned options left by deactivated plugins. Avoid deleting active plugin data.

steps.title: Remove Orphaned Post Meta
steps.instructions: Clean post meta rows with no parent post. Run only with a plugin designed for safe orphaned-data removal.

steps.title: Audit Large Autoloaded Options
steps.instructions: Identify oversized autoload options bloating every page load. Fix or disable the source plugin setting if possible.

steps.title: Optimize Database Tables
steps.instructions: Run OPTIMIZE TABLE via host tools or plugin after cleanup. Re-test site speed and admin performance.
